paragraphs: In the morning, neuropsychologists administer cognitive tests and record data. At midday, they review imaging, calculate scores, and write reports. In the afternoon, they deliver assessments and discuss interventions with families. They conduct research and write papers when time permits and take consultation calls while on duty.
